Container.Name: WonderMoney
Container.Overview:
Free, open-source personal finance for you and your household: accounts and bank sync, budgets, investments and net worth, in one place you host yourself.
This one container holds everything WonderMoney needs: its database (Postgres 16), file storage for imports and receipts, the API, the background jobs and the web app. Set APP_URL to the address you will open it at, then Apply. Secrets are generated on the first start and kept with the database in the app data folder: back that folder up, it is the whole instance.
The first account you create is the instance's owner. Email, AI features, market data and single sign-on are optional; the guide lists every setting.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port you open WonderMoney on. Keep it in step with APP_URL.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: The database, uploaded files and generated secrets. Back this folder up: without secrets.env, a restored database cannot read the stored bank credentials.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: The address you open WonderMoney at, without a path: http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:3000, or https://money.example.com behind a reverse proxy. Links in emails and sign-in redirects use it. Passkeys need an https hostname.

Config.Name: Instance name
Config.Description: Shown in the app, in emails and in authenticator apps.

Config.Name: Sign-up
Config.Description: open: anyone who can reach the server can sign up. invite: only people invited to a household. closed: nobody. The first account can always sign up.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, a Cloudflare tunnel): its address or network, such as 172.17.0.0/16, comma-separated. Sign-in limits then see each visitor's address. Empty when browsers reach this port directly.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user the app runs as and owns the app data folder.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group the app runs as.

Config.Name: Support email
Config.Description: Optional. Your inbox for account alerts and in-app feedback, shown as the support address.

Config.Name: Email sender
Config.Description: Optional. The address emails (password resets, invites) are sent from. Without email settings, they are written to the container log.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Optional. Your mail server.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: Optional. 587 for STARTTLS, 465 with SMTP_SECURE=true.

Config.Name: AI base URL
Config.Description: Optional. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama at http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:11434/v1) for receipt scanning, CSV column mapping, categorisation and the assistant.

Config.Name: AI API key
Config.Description: Optional. The endpoint's key.

Config.Name: AI model
Config.Description: Optional. The model to use, such as gpt-5.4-mini or llama3.2.

Config.Name: EODHD API key
Config.Description: Optional. For ticker search and live prices of investments.

Config.Name: Market data providers
Config.Description: Optional. eodhd, stooq, coingecko, in order, comma-separated. Stooq and CoinGecko are free and keyless; read their terms first. Empty means eodhd alone.

Config.Name: Database host
Config.Description: Optional. Your own Postgres 16 or later instead of the bundled one. Set the four settings below with it. Empty uses the bundled database in the app data folder.

Config.Name: Database port
Config.Description: Optional, with Database host.

Config.Name: Database name
Config.Description: Optional, with Database host.

Config.Name: Database user
Config.Description: Optional, with Database host.

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: Optional, with Database host.
